open_points.subject: activation authorization boundary
open_points.text: `module:surface` ... admits the request: any agent composes and proves; the owner or any agent asks to activate, an agent only a `read` version (A16 rule 3, A06).
open_points.question: Does `surface` admit every activation call by an owner or agent and let `flows` refuse an agent's effectful version as the operation's own `refused` result, or does `surface` reject that call as `not_permitted`?
options: `surface` admits every owner/agent activation call; `flows` returns `refused` for an agent activating a version above `read`.
`surface` treats effectful activation as unavailable to agents and returns `not_permitted` before `flows` runs.
open_points.default_guess: Follow the changed A16 rule 3 and the State 4 Errors paragraph: `surface` admits the call, then `flows` returns the operation-level `refused` result.
